svg.title: Here Xbi is the signed clover: one quarter of the four oriented plaquette curvature readings, with signs +, −, −, + for (+b, +i), (+b, −i), (−b, +i), (−b, −i). All are transported to the common base. Its adjoint covariance and antisymmetry follow by reversing the corresponding plaquette words. In a color orthonormal basis ec, the contact is P c XcDx,±i,ecF. The corresponding equation insertion is β⟨X, forcex,±i⟩−P cDx,±i,ecXc; Bb is its same signed sum divided by 2a5 N.
